text.body: 1 gaṇeśaṃ praṇipatyāhaṃ saṃdehānāṃ nivṛttaye | śīkṣāmanupravakṣyāmi vedānāṃ mūlakāraṇam || 1 || 2 vṛjane ja udāttaścedakāreṇa sahocyate | stutaṃ padaṃ tu vākyānte pracayaṃ parikīrtitam || 2 || 3 ā pañcamāddhavyapūrvo ghṛtenordhvaśca āhutam | vākyānto'pi tathā prokto yaḥpūrvastu na vidyate || 3 || 4 rādat paraśurantocce tviṅgyaḥ parśuśca bhaktitā | parṣaccehātiparṣā'pi svarabhaktestu nityatā || 4 || 5 pāpaṃ-viloma-pūrve cākārṣaṃ kārṣīttadādiṣu | svarabhaktiṃ vijānīyānnānyavarṇo'tra saṃbhavet || 5 || 6 agne tānnapate trīṃśca triṣṭubhā caivamādbhavet | kṣiprā bhartrya-yitrya-1rātrya-mantrya-pitryāpi kāṭhake || 6 || 7 samāne tu pade hrasvāḥ sahalrā viralāśca ye | juṣṭo vācaḥ prajāgniṃci1 mānomitra udasta ca || 7 || 8 agnirvāva ca devā vai keśavāpavidhāyakaḥ | rakṣāṃsītyanuvākeṣu hyapyetīkāravānbhavet || 8 || 9 chandā yā te-na barhiśca iddhyā agne bṛhanpare | yajñasya pūrva iṣṭyai ca tvikārādiḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 9 || 10 akāriṣaṃ ca ṇaḥ pūrvo rīriṣo rīriṣannapi | tāriṣaccāriṣaṃ cet syāt svarabhaktirna vidyate || 10 || 11 upasargeṣu pūrveṣu tviyurityatra vidyate | juṣṭaḥpraśnakāṇḍācchidrāraṇyake mānuṣī saīt || 11 || 12 viniṣparyasuraḥpūrvakrīyetyatra na te pare | cātūrathasyapūrvānyau hotrī maptrī ca dīrghagau || 12 || 13 potrī neṣṭrī svasrī stotrī śatarudrī na ṇāṃ paraḥ | varīyasī ca pīyūṣo davīyo'tha hrasīya ca || 13 || 14 cīyate ca dvitīyaśca tṛtīyādau tathaiva ca | pīyati tvastṛtīyaścāvṛkāste ūrdhvagāmīyuḥ || 14 || 15 svarottarapapūrve tu śaṣahordhve tu madhyagaḥ | rephādukāra eva syāt svarabhaktirna vidyate || 15 || 16 rādutvamaruṣaśruccedaruhadruha cāruham | tikruṣṭa cakruṣaścakruḥ kruṅṅa-mu-kṣa-ddha-rottare || 16 || 17 pa-ha-ṇā-ma-ta ūrdhve ca tvabhi-mitra-kapūrvake | drupadaṃ vai dru dhruvā'dhruṅ nānādṛtya dṛtiśrutiḥ || 17 || 18 dṛśe'nādṛtya dṛṣadaḥ uddṛṣṭa uddhṛtoddhṛtaḥ | ca vi me nama ā devaḥ stuhīha havanetyasis || 18 || 19 vājaṃ vo vai sita svarṣiṃ tapo me hṛdaye na ca | gaṇ mācyordhva śrutaḥ śruṣṭī śrudhī śrut śmaśru śuśruvān || 19 || 20 dvitvaṃ cāpyṛtavo yajño rvataḥ pūrvaṃ śritaḥ sait | parinyayo vacordhve ca sruti śabdaśca sasruṣaḥ || 20 || 21 sruk pade sruhyukāraḥ syātsasṛvāṃ sa na vidyate | ṣāntaḥ pruṭ srukti cordhvaśca vāgbhrū śubhru ca śatru ca || 21 || 22 bhrumiṃ bhruvigrumuṣṭiśca kṣāmanruruca vavru rut | śatamittyān ca māmasmān pūrvaṃ nīdutvamucyate || 22 || 23 juhvatyapyāhi juhve'ntyasvāro gṛhṇopabhottare | ukāravān juhvaśabdaḥ saṃdhānaṃ parato na cet || 23 || 24 devānāṃ tve kratuṃ cāsau yajamāneṣu ṣāttadut | bhūtebhyaḥ prokṣati tasmādvibhūrdevāyataḥ pare || 24 || 25 vṛṣṭyahṛta ṛkāraḥ syād vivā yasya ha ṛdhyate | akṣarāntaḷkāro yaḥ svaro jñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 25 || 26 udāhṛtaḥ kḷptaśabde na padādyantayoḥ svaraḥ | baddhaine sā bhave maicca yenta ekādaśatrayam || 26 || 27 gnīpūrvato juṣetāṃ ca prathamo'ñjantisatyayoḥ | yekeśinaḥ saaikāro vyaicchannityatra varṇitaḥ || 27 || 28 praiyamedhā āsan naiyagrodha-praiyaṃgavaṃ yathā | dohai yajñaṃ ca vaiyāghre daiyāṃpātyaitvagā ime || 28 || 29 brahmavarprendriyaṃ cendri paśūnvīryamanuparaḥ | mukhato jyotirūrjāya evāsmai caivamaid bhavet || 29 || 30 trīn, brahma vyagni, cendrāgnī, medasaicca purohaviḥ | enau vivā indrasyāyurādāvante'gnaye'nnavat || 30 || 31 sphyena yāṃ pari gharmāpanuttyai teṣāṃ parāṇuttyai | ita uttaraṃ kakārādiprathamān vakṣyāmaḥ | antaḥsthābhyaḥ pavargācca svarebhyaḥ pūrvataḥ sthitau || 31 || 32 triṣṭuk śabdastathā'nuṣṭuk kakārāntāvitīritau | anyatra tu pakārāntāvetāviti viniścitau || 32 || 33 pūrvasya tu bidhestatra vaiparītyamiti sthitiḥ || 33 || 34 cakṣe sū śraddhaūrdhve ka utkaro'ntocca eva kaḥ | viṣṭutaṃ kṛṣṭaśabdaśca pacyordhvaḥ ṣāt parastu ṭaḥ || 34 || 35 tvaṣṭre vasvagnaye prātarmatyā aṣṭākapālamat | vaiśvānaraśca juṣṭo'mbe śaṃ no'gnirnaśca tāriṣat || 35 || 36 parāpātvebhyaevainat brahmādyekāpa eva taḥ | viduṣo haviṣā cainat vedatpaśurṛtavyataḥ || 36 || 37 thamenātmānaṃ spṛṇuta spṛṇoti spṛta sāṃhitaḥ | prāṇānāṃ spṛtyai dvāveva lokaspṛte brahmaspṛtam || 37 || 38 saghā caturtho node'si saghyāsaṃ lānyamegha ca | raghā'naghābhya āghā'gha praghātaścaiva moghaṃ ca || 38 || 39 kriyāśabdaśca yatraiva tadanyo ghana jaṅgha ca | punastuvī pratūrtiśca tvāvataśca bṛhatkṛdhi || 39 || 40 syandatā ye valaṃ vidma ca no vasu suretasam | pūrvo maghaḥ pitṛśabdaḥ paro vā maghavaśrutiḥ || 40 || 41 trīṇi prāṇādi viśvānyo jighām̐san yo jaghantha ca | ṭavarge'pi caturthatvaṃ voḍhavetyādirucyate || 41 || 42 yadakrandaśca dīdhyāno bhirvastedhastu cartudhā | brahmanpañcāntyamedhāśca tanūvarcapayordhvagaḥ || 42 || 43 upāyajño yeta īśā, jī, sī, sū, dakṣi, meparaḥ | pari, syanaḥ, punaḥ, rdehivedyūrdhve ca caturthakaḥ || 43 || 44 yasya svāhā paraḥ cedvā karmaṇyaṃ śravaṇo varam | nayāsmākaṃ yamo me no dhātā vedo manastataḥ || 44 || 45 indraḥ pūrvo dadātvanyaḥ sukutādyuttare ca dhaḥ | tenāyureṣāṃ rūpāṇāṃ trayastriṃśattathaiva ca || 45 || 46 śa-ma-sa-pra-ca-nordhvaśca kāmenānnātparo'pi ca | caturthyantaparo'pi syādābhyo ye'dhvaryave'pi ca || 46 || 47 agnīdhe brahmaṇe hotre cainat barhiṣi dakṣiṇām | tārpyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vai dhenumātmanā yaścapūrvakaḥ || 47 || 48 dadātīti tṛtīyatvaṃ tadanyatra ca saṃpibat | yā, mānobhriṃ rucannīṃ śūnā, mannādyaṃ, rabhi svayam || 48 || 49 yaṃ sū ddhi, cī, ndriyaṃ, datte dheyamātmanna dho [matu] | brūhyavasaḥ, turīpaṃ, thaṃ jahi ohaiḥ , vikṣu, saprathāḥ || 49 || 50 śociramutra bhūyāt bhūḥ śrṛṇvai raśmiranāgasaḥ | devaṃ bhūyiṣṭhabhājaśca sahadhyai pūrvatastvatha || 50 || 51 vamadābasaśatrāśca sasvarā gokuro ayaḥ | svarapūrvā amītvādyā akārādyaśca tatradhaḥ || 51 || 52 radhāmadradhasī gādhaṃ kḷdhānadhaḥ ṣatoradham | kṣudhakṣodhuspṛdhonādhai māgaghaṃ vivadhādadha || 52 || 53 vāvṛdha vaimṛdha vyādha yudhaśrudvīvṛdhādadhuḥ | rudhaśrudṛṇadhannaddho nādhamāna rarādha ca || 53 || 54 gavīdhukasridha grodhamidadhajjanadhāḥ ṣadha | padānte ca dhikāro'pi rādhaśrudavadhiṣmaca || 54 || 55 adhoniṣṭyā vi ghoṣavadyuktaḥ padādigastvapi | aśvābhidhānīmiṣudhe tvabādhanta vibādha ca || 55 || 56 kāyādhavaśca nidha ca nirbādhābadhiropi ca | asādhayata gaudhūmaṃ gāvīdhukamiti sthitiḥ || 56 || 57 nākārāntavṛthādyuccā artho'rthaṃ tīrtha pārtha ca | vītho'bhāgorthaśabdastu rūthyo nirṛtha eva ca || 57 || 58 jagantha ghantha tatantha dādhartha mo vavartha ca | methīṃ mathita thāyanti rāthītaro vimātha ca || 58 || 59 vetthāvṛthaṃ cāvṛthāśca jaharthāsthnā tathaiva ca | antoccakāvithetthau ca visargāntau na cecchithi || 59 || 60 gramātthnaśca vidathyaṃ ca katiyūrūpapūrvakaḥ || 60 || 61 śrṛṃ paṃ graṃ maṃ ca māṃ pūrvaḥ samāne tu caturtha ca | mathyamāno rathyasvāraḥ pṛthvī rāthantaro'pi ca || 61 || 62 phala phena phaṇat pharvya śaphebhyo'nyo bha ucyate | vaiśaṃbhalyā ca śībhādau pavarge ca caturthagaḥ || 62 || 63 avāṅiti ṅakārāntaṃ nābhimūrdhvaṃ ca sarvadā | yācñaiva ca ñakārāntamupajñu ca tathaiva ca || 63 || 64 kasmā upa ya rā jācca ne navarṇātparau ca ye | tapūrvau taparau syātāṃ jañāvanyau ganau smṛtau || 64 || 65 bhūyāṃsa unantaśabdoccaśaṃstāsūrdhvoṃho'taṃsayat | unnavaṃśaṃ strīṣasādaṃ sāvanyo mukhoccakaḥ || 65 || 66 ātām̐sīccham̐sine śam̐sannāsikyo duṣadam̐ sadaḥ | śabdaikye raṣapūrvo ṇo vyoveto spṛṣateḥ kvacit || 66 || 67 carmaṇ carṣaṇ vṛṣaṇ śīrṣaṇ brahmaṇṇakṣaṇṇavagrahe | vāṇaśśatāṇavaścāpi meṇyādau prākṛtaśca ṇaḥ || 67 || 68 bastapūrvaparo vṛṣṇi vṛṣṇā vṛṣṇaśca vṛṣṇiyam | rundhe hukaḥ pūrvādyajño viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kramoditau || 68 || 69 anto'nantyaṃ na vai indrastasyāprati na madhyagam | tārpya ca rundhate tveṣu dadhate syātparatra tu || 69 || 70 ekaikastrivṛdāgneyaṃ viśvā yuñjanti cāgnaye | tvaṃ hyapa vai na devordhve indraśrat pura āditaḥ || 70 || 71 navānye dadhate vidvām̐saḥ sādhyāḥ ṣaḍṛtavo vai | pṛthivyai jājāyantenya eṣvatiṣṭhanta ityapi || 71 || 72 kusurubindo'pratiṣṭhāṃ ca utkrā prajāpatirnava | āyurvā anta ādityaṃ prajāgniṃ taṃ pra saṃtatiḥ || 72 || 73 dhiṣṇyādvitīyaṃ ca sākaṃ devasya sphayaṃ tu bārha ca | brahma dvitīyatṛtīye puruṣaṃ pratipūruṣam || 73 || 74 devā mitho devasyāhaṃ cyavante caiṣu tadvidhiḥ | vāgvā indrastrivṛdbarhirnaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayanti ca || 74 || 75 vivā etā vapratiṣṭhāṃ tārpyaṃ tṛtīyaturyayoḥ | saṃtatiryasya yuñjanti tārpyeṇāsuryamantagam || 75 || 76 prajāpatiḥ śukramādiyatpaśuḥ samardhayanti naḥ | sāvyūrdhvaṃ tryahā bhavanti na pratyaṅ pṛṣṭhya āpṛthi || 76 || 77 ādyā vaindramukṣā''gneyīṃ tayāsminnaprathatpare | pūrvo medhā yālabhanta hyādanto'snā bhavecca naḥ || 77 || 78 te bhaviṣyanti devāsustebhyaḥ ṣaḍdvā paraśca cchan | indro'gacchadagacchantyasau devānāṃ nendriyaṃ tu chan || 78 || 79 devasya raśa, sāvitraṃ medhyānevainā ucyate | devānāgnau pūrvaṃ tu samīcyenānnirantaram || 79 || 80 syātte tāstānyathonatvaṃ bahuśruti dadhatyapi | saṃvatsaro dvi sādhyartava ādityādve yathā'jān || 80 || 81 suvarayāma cādityāḥ prajāpatyāṅgiro'pi cet | bhūtvā puruṣa dāmāpi dyāvā śakuni saṃśritam || 81 || 82 tena brahmāntareṇordhvo hiraṇmayo'tra saṃsmṛtaḥ | pārāvagatya bahūnāmivordhvaḥ samane'pi maḥ || 82 || 83 vāruṇo'nte dvirevaināṃ ime'vanti ca saptabhiḥ | yajuṣāgneḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭīścaināṃ brahmā tu dīrghataḥ || 83 || 84 pīvonnāṃ prathamaṃ caiva hariṃ prathamajāṃ ca maḥ | agnaye nāso, dhātrādi prajāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca sarvataḥ || 84 || 85 yāmiti munikāṇḍe cāpyardhukaṃ syādvisarjayet | aitvaṃ hitvā ṣyatordhvaścat aimadhye ya ekataḥ || 85 || 86 nivṛścata vṛścataśca anyo vṛścyata teparaḥ | yoniḥ puṇyo havai yoniṃ tasmādgarbho yajai mahai || 86 || 87 maho ya eṣa, sya histha pūrva ṛtviya eva yaḥ | yadagne tu yaviṣṭhyātra sakārordhvo na hotayuk || 87 || 88 uṣasaṃ cāmṛtaṃ pūrve martyāso'tra ya ucyate | ākārāntorayiṣṭhā ca astabhnāddyāṃdasaṃyutam || 88 || 89 virājyepratyasaddevā saṃvatsartuvivai paraḥ | marteṣvayognirūrdhve tu pūrvaścādyuccamiṅgyagam || 89 || 90 antodātta suvargaśca lokaśabdapare'pi vā | vīryasya nasya cānātyai rādhnuvantyapyarephatā || 90 || 91 yuktottamācca pūrvaṃ tu śabdaikye nā'nunāsikaḥ | manojayadu yatpañca trayastriṃśat paro'nudat || 91 || 92 ādyudātte tatheṅgyasthe dvitvaṃ vātra grahe garau | tavyāḥ ṣyordhve'pyṛkārānte na medhapatisottare || 92 || 93 evainaṃ ca patiṃ sākṣāttābhirantaṃ mukhaṃ tathā | ṛtena mukhataḥ pūrvo ra syādārabhate'nvapi || 93 || 94 agauḥ pūrve tu yajñaṃ cānvātmānaṃ vatsaraṃ tathā | yajñenordhvo gṛhītvā svāttordhva ārabhya rephagaḥ || 94 || 95 naran rabhetvanārabdho'sya prakṣyaḥ pravatāpi ca | paśumāditrayaṃ prakṣo devā hotrā ca ro'samaḥ || 95 || 96 atapyataparaḥ somaścādyāḥ pañca ruṇyataraḥ | sūryādityapayodhātā dūrādapi ca sauryaraḥ || 96 || 97 eka maitra juhotyūrdhvo nāṅgdhyūrdhvo jaritāra ca | nāsikyalatvamadhye vo'nyaṃvlīnāsaṃvliyāya ca || 97 || 98 dīrgha prajāvatīrvaśca nakṣaikāvaṃ grahāvahai | trisaptagrāmyāḥ paśavo vasvyathaikātrivṛtparaḥ || 98 || 99 sve bhavedyatane dheye stome yonāvṛtauparaḥ | svayā devatayetyatra hyaikārāntaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 99 || 100 kaṣacāṣajaṣāśabdāḥ caṣālmamāṣavājakaḥ | ṣāṭ cānavarṇa pūrvaḥ ṣaṇ nadakordhvo yathā maṣam || 100 || 101 sakhyā śreṣṭhaḥ pade sa syādidhyase'tra sa ucyate | yo'sau, catuḥsasarveṣāṃ ; yadyaśvā[pa] samardhayat || 101 || 102 vīte eva ca te; gnītau amīsāmeva setyapi | satraṃ kena vaiparyantaṃ ekasaṃkhyādvayātrayuk || 102 || 103 chando; devā surāstena pūrvaṃ vṛṣṭisanīḥ paśuḥ | yathādhatta tṛtīyāntā yathāvai mānta vānta ca || 103 || 104 yatpatnyādīndra iṣṭargo yajuṣā chanda ityapi | no bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte syādātman yajñasya saṃ paca || 104 || 105 devāsurābruvannādau tathā dadhata kīrtitam | sarvā vayo vai jyotiṣmaḥ kurute devakadraviṇ || 105 || 106 te'smāt sṛṣṭāśca narkṣainān paśūnparaḥ patiḥ paśūn | yāvaitanmedapūrvedyuryajñaṃ ca manasātanu || 106 || 107 taṃ sṛpra so'bibhetso'smāt so'śvo'gnimasṛjāpi ca | yaśasartukṣuracinuta pṛthivyagnyacikīṣata || 107 || 108 anujāvaraṃ paraṃ caindraṃ rājānaṃ somameva ca | sā sṛṣṭāśvavirājaṃ ca so'gniṃ ca puruṣaṃ tathā || 108 || 109 sa indraṃ tatparo devā surāniti ca kīrtitam | so'smāttaṃ sṛṣṭamityasminnaśvamedhaṃ pare tathā || 109 || 110 agnihotraṃ pare yajñān devānte pāpmanā paraḥ | viśvakarmāta ūrdhvaṃ tu vyānaṃ madhyaṃ paroṃ'śunā || 110 || 111 na kastvā vākyavad granthe na svāhordhvaikavākyake | prajā trivṛt vasīyān syāt pūrvaṃ tu svayamuttarā || 111 || 112 pradaśahotāraṃ tena dvādaśāsurapūrvakam | prānyā'muṃpūrvamambhāṃsi savitā dvayamadhyagam || 112 || 113 agnidvitīyatṛtīye devāścaivaṃparadvayam | yāvatī prathame turye yadekenādigatrayam || 113 || 114 bhūmirādidvayaṃ cāsmiṃścāmuṣmim̐śceti sarvataḥ | antyaṃ tu jyotirāpo vā ime vā eta eva ca || 114 || 115 prajāpatī rakṣāṃsyevaprajāpatirnavaiṣu ca | ādau nayati vittānvavāṇuśaḥśoyunaktyaman || 115 || 116 darbhāsyāsmādviśānīmamabrāhmaṇa iti tvataḥ | dvirudvayasyapasyāśvasadṛśatrayamadhyagaḥ || 116 || 117 dvitīya sasṛvāṃso'vadhattāmuttamaṃ juhuyāt | vetvāhā'haṃtriste nandā āhvayatā ca diśyati || 117 || 118 uttamae ikārāntā rephācca varṇataḥ kramāt | vyutkramāvasyavānyā yatsubhagā dadatu priyam || 118 || 119 ghṛtabhūtakṛtāvocca pṛthivītvāradabruvan | rātryasyatyatyahaścandra vā yonirnavaiṣyathaḥ || 119 || 120 etenoktaṃ nyadāgneyaḥ paśavono vicāratha | prāṇamamṛta ādityaḥ satanūpasṛpānuvi || 120 || 121 tasmā eta mavācastvā sajātā hyāya cātithiḥ | juṣantāṃ puṣkalebhiśca syātāṃ jīvāṃśca tejasā || 121 || 122 tedakṣanta puroḍāśaṃ diśo'smākaṃ ca duṣkaram | viṣṇoṣṭabhnācca dādhartha nirghnanti yāmi cemi cet || 122 || 123 maye hanidhinā cogramanyastigmaṃ ca maṣmaṣā | pipratotho adhīyīta paridattādamaṃ phalā || 123 || 124 dviviṣādyapidhānaṃ ca rohordhvo, yajamāna at | [diśo'smākaṃ stavāni yat subhagā rdhūrdadatvapi | ghṛtabhūtakṛtāvoccaiḥ pṛthivyai tvāradabruvan || rātriyāsyatyahaścandrā vā yonirna upaiṣyatha | tasmā eta mavācastvā sajātā hyāya cātithiḥ || ete tasyānyadāgneyaḥ paśavo na tathā vici | adharāmṛta ādityasatanūpasṛṣṭhānuvi || juṣantāṃ puṣkalebhyejajjīvānasmākaṃ māmita | mayeha nidhanogramanyastigmena ca maṣmaṣā || viṣṇo'ṣṭabhnācca dādhartha nirghnanti yāmi cemi ca | te dakṣanta puroḍāśaṃ pidhānamasi duṣkaram || piprato'tho'pyadhīyīta paridattādidaṃ phalā | tejasā'smai ca saṃyantu avigrāhaṃ ca viṣyatām || parastādaviṣādī ca aṇubhirbhāsi roha ca | āsādayedāsavitre saśīrṣṇā hyāśiṣo'sma ca ||] eveti ha visargau ca madhye cāntevayopyuśan || 124 || 125 devā indriya idaṃ vā indrovṛtrā praketunā | yā vāṃ ca pavamāno'yaṃ vāvatṛtīya ityapi || 125 || 126 dvitīye tu pradevaṃ hi devīḥ, prācīna, caiva cet | samiddho agniḥ saṃkrūraṃ suvardākṣi ca nānyataḥ || 126 || 127 vaiparītyaṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ parā vaiśvānaro'gnaye | devasyāhaṃ, ca sarvāṇi,
